title: Glessner's roofs ruled red tile, though every old print shows grey
items: Glessner House keeps its red, unglazed clay tile roofs, the stable cupola's included. Glessner's own account of the house names them, and the 1963 survey found clay tile under a later coat of tar. Old photographs show the roofs grey because they are black and white, and the 1960s ones show the tar.
